platform: Linux x86_64, admin-vps, own existing HISTOR image

fixture.payload_selection: Per-length interior window beyond known format prefix, preferably mixed letters/digits; no key is discarded for having a late first digit.

measures: normalized exact-window corpus hits (not request FP rate)
full hook decisions on bounded public-source excerpt fixtures
detector-only attack recognition separate from credential-boundary decisions
collision-enriched counterexamples paired with matching synthetic key
limitations: Not production traffic or a human-approval rate.
Synthetic format strings, not working provider credentials.
Corpus/hash partition and independent second key seed do not establish population representativeness.
Fresh-session threshold ablations do not test a production fingerprint-store migration.

transfer.initial_large_archive: rejected by automatic review; not transferred
transfer.minimal_archive: 21 files explicitly authorized by user and transferred

final_decision.change: Add windows before the first digit after recognized normalized provider prefixes; retain generic/DER start rules and all old hashes.
final_decision.rejected: Expand generic alphabetic prefixes: false hard denial of public word/year control.
